paper.title_en: Charged Letelier--Alencar Black Strings with a Quintessence and the Cosmolgical Constant
paper.abstract_en: This study derives charged black string solutions in the presence of a Letelier--Alencar cloud of strings and quintessence within Einstein--Maxwell--$Λ$ theory. We study the curvature scalars in order to investigate the asymptotical behavior of these solutions. We calculate the relevant conserved and thermodynamic quantities, confirming their compliance with the first law of thermodynamics. System stability is rigorously analyzed through heat capacity and Gibbs free energy, identifying regimes of local and global equilibrium. Additionally, by interpreting the cosmological constant as thermodynamic pressure within an extended phase space, we establish the validity of the extended first law and derive the corresponding Smarr relation for these solutions. We also investigate the null geodesic structure, deriving the equation for the photon cylinder radius, which generalizes the known result for charged black strings by incorporating the effects of the Letelier--Alencar cloud of strings and quintessence. The numerical analysis of this equation determines the existence and location of photon cylinders as functions of the model parameters.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在Einstein--Maxwell--Λ理论中推导带有Letelier--Alencar弦云与精质的带电黑弦解，系统计算守恒量与热力学量并验证第一定律，分析热容与Gibbs自由能稳定性，并在扩展相空间下建立扩展第一定律与Smarr关系，还给出光子柱半径方程及数值分析。内容理论深度较高，方法较完整，与黑洞热力学及广义相对论基础紧密相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 带有精质与宇宙学常数的带电Letelier--Alencar黑弦
decision.abstract_zh: 本研究在Einstein--Maxwell--$Λ$理论中，推导了在存在Letelier--Alencar弦云与精质情况下的带电黑弦解。我们研究曲率标量，以考察这些解的渐近行为。我们计算相关的守恒量与热力学量，确认其符合热力学第一定律。通过热容与Gibbs自由能对系统稳定性进行严格分析，识别局部与全局平衡的区域。此外，通过在扩展相空间中将宇宙学常数解释为热力学压强，我们建立扩展第一定律的有效性，并推导出这些解相应的Smarr关系。我们还研究零测地线结构，推导光子柱半径的方程，该方程通过纳入Letelier--Alencar弦云与精质的影响，推广了已知的带电黑弦结果。对该方程的数值分析确定了光子柱作为模型参数的函数的存在性与位置。
